name: Foreign Currency Information
sourceRefs: PyX12 (azoner/pyx12) 835.5010.X221.A1.xml — the authoritative source for this segment. Every position from CUR03 onward (Exchange Rate, the second Entity/Currency pair, and all 5 repeating date/time-qualifier trios from CUR07-21) is marked usage="N" (Not Used) by this Implementation Guide — this segment collapses to just 2 usable elements. Supersedes an earlier version of this file that modeled a full 21-element segment with a 5-trio repeat group, built from Stedi's generic (X12 Release 8010) page before the version-mismatch issue was caught; the repeat-group MECHANISM itself remains a validated, reusable capability (see CAS/PLB), it simply isn't needed here.
